subject: POC: align load window, routing plan & test-harness confirmation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: POC: align load window, routing plan & test-harness confirmation

Hi Rachel / Tom —

Following our discovery call last week: wed like to lock in the hands-on load run for the POC and confirm a few operational details so the session is productive. High-level asks:

- Confirm a 3-hour run window where we can execute ramp -> sustain -> teardown (suggested slots below).
- Confirm throughput targets and latency SLOs we should validate (we have a default but want to align).
- Confirm if we should run on your dedicated sandbox or use Redwood-hosted dedicated pool for the exercise.
- Please review the attached draft runbook and the test matrix (acme_test_matrix.csv) and flag any gaps.

Suggested windows (all EDT):
- Tue Oct 20, 09:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Tue Oct 20, 13:00–16:00
- Wed Oct 21, 08:00–11:00

Baseline metrics we plan to validate (please confirm):
- Target throughput: 200 req/s sustained for 30m, 400 req/s peak bursts
- Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms for 95% of keys
- Error budget threshold: 1% overall error rate during sustain window

Test harness & artifacts:
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/acme-poc-harness (load driver, scenario configs)
- Runbook (attached): contains step-by-step commands + rollback instructions

If the 09:00 slot works well lock it and send the calendar invite + pre-run checklist. If you prefer a different throughput target (e.g., 500 req/s baseline) let us know so we can increase node counts and adjust cost estimates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood_poc_runbook_draft.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB); acme_test_matrix.csv (csv, 8KB)

From: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC: align load window, routing plan & test-harness confirmation

Jonas —

Thanks, this looks great and thorough. Quick notes from our side:

- Tue Oct 20 09:00–12:00 EDT works for the core SRE + ML infra team. Well involve product at the start for prompt/context questions but theyll drop after the first 30 min.
- Confirmed baseline: our Product asked to validate 300 req/s sustained (higher than your baseline). Can Redwood provision to run 300 req/s with p95 < 350ms?
- Were open to Redwoods hosted dedicated pool for isolation for the run — saves us setup time. We do need a short window beforehand to ensure keys and traffic routing are correct.

Small ask: can you put a short checklist in the calendar invite for pre-run steps (env, keys, test IDs to use)? Also can you confirm which telemetry endpoints youll stream metrics to (we use prom/grafana internally; we can federate or scrape).

Tom, fyi — Ive attached our internal test matrix (same as the CSV you got) and the list of dataset variants we plan to use.

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Lee
Technical Program Manager, ML Platforms | Acme Corporation
Rachel.Lee@acme.com | +1 212-555-0167

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@acme.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC: align load window, routing plan & test-harness confirmation

Morning all —

We can absolutely run the 09:00–12:00 EDT slot today. Confirming operational details from Redwoods side:

- We will run on Redwood-hosted dedicated pool (pre-warmed), 3–4 GPU workers as needed to hit 300 req/s.
- Harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/acme-poc-harness (we pushed an updated scenario that adds header-level routing tests).
- Telemetry: we will expose a Prometheus scrape endpoint and push an aggregated metrics stream to the shared Grafana dashboard. Link will be in the invite.
- Pre-run checklist (we will paste into invite):
  * Confirm API keys (we will provision short-lived keys for the window)
  * Confirm dataset variant name (Rachel, your CSV lists variants V1/V2 — default to V2 unless you ask otherwise)
  * Confirm routing policy for multi-model fallback (we will enable model-fallback->smaller-quantized variant on errors)

Well plan a quick 20-min sanity check at 08:30 to validate keys and connectivity, then start ramp at 09:00.

Ill attach the run commands well execute to the calendar invite and a link to the runbook draft. If anything changes ping me in the invite thread.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: run_commands.sh (text, 3KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC: align load window, routing plan & test-harness confirmation

Great — thanks everyone. Calendar invite is sent for Tue Oct 20 08:30–12:00 EDT (08:30 pre-run sanity / 09:00 ramp). Invite body includes: pre-run checklist, Prometheus endpoint, GitHub harness link, and attachments (runbook + run_commands.sh).

A couple of final operational notes:
- Canary/fallback: well enable a canary policy that routes 10% of traffic to a quantized fallback model if latency breaches 500ms during ramp; we will scale it back down automatically after the sustain window.
- Data handling: no customer data will be persisted outside the session; logs are ephemeral and will be redacted per the runbook.
- Post-run: we will send a short report (CSV + grafana snapshots) within 24 hours and propose next steps for rollout.

If anyone from Acme wants to run an extra routing scenario (header-based routing, user-seg split) call it out now so we can add it to the scenario list.

See you at 08:30 EDT.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Calendar: invite (ics) attached; Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XyzRunbookDraft
